paragraphs: RecordKeeper is a modern, full-stack web application designed for efficient record management. It allows users to create, view, search, edit, and delete records, complete with a clean user interface powered by Shadcn UI and robust authentication provided by Clerk.
features: User Authentication: Secure sign-up and sign-in using Clerk, ensuring only authenticated users can access records.
Dynamic Pagination: Efficiently browse through large sets of records with a fully functional pagination system (previous/next buttons, page numbers, ellipses).
Modern UI: A clean, responsive, and visually appealing user interface built with Shadcn UI components and Tailwind CSS.
Toast Notifications: User-friendly, non-intrusive alerts for success and error messages.

requirements.text: User Authentication: Secure sign-up and sign-in using Clerk, ensuring only authenticated users can access records.

You will be prompted to sign in or sign up when you first visit the page.
